subject: JOYAI_TALKER_2608_01119

primary_sources.title: JoyAI-Talker: Full-Duplex Speech Interactive Large Model Built for Empathetic Voice Agents

primary_sources.observation: Current search did not surface an official JoyAI-Talker model/weights entry. This is a search observation, not proof that no release exists anywhere.

source_supported_facts.architecture: Decoupled Duplex-Thinker-Talker with a state-driven plug-and-play Joy-Duplex interaction layer.
source_supported_facts.thinker_backbone: JoyAI-LLM Flash sparse MoE, 48.9B total parameters, approximately 3.28B activated per input token.
source_supported_facts.duplex_controller: 1.7B decoder-only Joy-Duplex model consuming streaming audio embeddings and emitting interleaved text/state tokens.
source_supported_facts.paper_full_duplex_claim: Response rate 0.88 under user interruptions with low false-trigger behavior on Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 as reported by the authors.
source_supported_facts.tool_agent_claim: Paper and official project page describe multi-turn reasoning/tool-use voice-agent capability.
source_supported_facts.talker_training_language_scope: Paper describes a multilingual Talker corpus but does not provide a German-specific acceptance result in the text searched.

GERMAN_FIRST_ACCEPTANCE.reason: No German-specific benchmark/result was found in the primary paper text; a multilingual training statement is insufficient for Frankenstein German-first acceptance.

LOCAL_SELF_HOSTED_RUNNABLE.reason: This triage did not locate an official JoyAI-Talker/Joy-Duplex code-and-weights release that can be pinned, downloaded, audited and run locally.

TARGET_HARDWARE_FIT.reason: Sparse active-parameter count does not establish resident-memory/runtime fit; no target hardware execution was performed.

F2_ABI_FIT.reason: State-driven duplex gating, explicit accept/reject/backchannel semantics and decoupled speech/cognition boundaries map well to the existing VoiceIntent/presence/cancellation philosophy, but no executable F2 integration was attempted.

high_value_inference: Treat Joy-Duplex primarily as an architecture/turn-control donor until a reproducible release exists. Its 1.7B interaction layer is more directly relevant to Frankenstein's low-latency presence/interruptibility boundary than the full 48.9B Thinker replacement.

next_executable_falsifier.precondition: Obtain an official or author-linked Joy-Duplex/JoyAI-Talker code+weights revision with license and artifact hashes.
next_executable_falsifier.experiment: Run a network-blocked German full-duplex triage against pinned interruption/background/backchannel fixtures and measure response/false-trigger behavior plus resource envelope before any Trigger4 promotion.
next_executable_falsifier.route_if_release_absent: Keep as VOICE_ARCHITECTURE_DONOR/SOURCE_PINNED_TRIAGE only; do not spend VPS integration capacity.
